1020.a: Japan, 〒633-1202 Nara, Uda District, Soni, Taroji, 169 花あかり
1020.aj: 〒633-1202 奈良県宇陀郡曽爾村太良路１６９ 花あかり
1020.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Okinawan cuisine, including flavorful Soki Soba and Goya Champuru, with generous portions. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the warm, welcoming atmosphere, reminiscent of a grandmother's home. Others also say the staff are friendly and attentive.
1020.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、本格的な沖縄料理を高く評価しています。特に、風味豊かなソーキそばやゴーヤチャンプルーなどがあり、どれもボリューム満点でおいしいというクチコミが多くあります。また、価格が手頃であることや、おばあちゃんの家のような温かく居心地の良い雰囲気が特徴です。スタッフも親しみやすく、丁寧な対応だと評判のようです。

rv.t: It'a a wonderful little place in Soni Village, specializes in Okinawa ramen. The owner who cooked the food understand that I don't eat pork and made the ramen soup from fish especially for me. I appreciate her kindness. She also serve a homemade tofus made from peanut which was one of the kind and it's SUPER delicious.
山登りの帰りに ランチ先を探してたら まさかの沖縄料理の幟旗🚩 曽爾村で沖縄料理って😱 コレは行くしかないって事で 行ってきました♪ 沖縄料理では 沖縄そばとゴーヤ定食だったかな？ 沖縄そばを食べました。 BGMには、沖縄民謡がw 美味しく頂きました😋
何にもない田舎に急に現れたこの花あかり なぜ？という感じ笑 沖縄料理なのですがすっごく美味しいです！ オススメ☆

1020.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1021.a: APA HOTEL＆RESORT OSAKA NAMBA EKIMAE TOWER, 1 Chome-2-13 Minatomachi, Naniwa Ward, Osaka, 556-0017, Japan
1021.aj: 〒556-0017 大阪府大阪市浪速区湊町１丁目２−１３ アパホテル＆リゾート〈大阪なんば駅前タワー〉
catj: エステティック サロン
コンビニエンスストア
1021.ed: People say this hotel offers clean, well-organized rooms with thoughtful amenities, and features a large public bath with various tubs and a sauna. They also highlight the convenient on-site 7-Eleven, excellent location near Namba Station, and delicious breakfast buffet. Some reviews mention the rooms can be small and stuffy.
1021.edj: クチコミでは、このホテルは清潔で整頓された部屋と気の利いたアメニティが備わっていると評判です。また、さまざまな浴槽とサウナがある広い大浴場が特徴として挙げられています。便利な館内にあるセブンイレブン、難波駅に近い素晴らしい立地、そして美味しい朝食ビュッフェも高く評価されています。 一方で、部屋が狭く、空気がこもっているという声も一部のクチコミで見られます。

rv.t: Amazing hotel!! Great location!! Basically it is connected to Namba Station, just a short one minute walk outside and you’re inside the OCAT building Which leads directly to Namba Station! The hotel is clean, and the breakfast is amazing , which is a true highlight!! Oh, it’s a 6 to 10 minute walk to Dotonburi and ither amazing shops and restaurants, so awesome! The only thing that I had an issue with is the…

This is my 2nd stay here. Love the cleanliness, the osen which offers multiple pools, the systematic luggage storage/collection process. The best part is the airport limo bus stops right behind the hotel on 2nd floor of the OCAT Building. You don't even need to cross any roads or take any stairs since escalator is available.Simple use the massive underpass walkway to connect to Namba shopping malls like Takashimaya…

The photos of this place look great, and I was very excited to stay here. However, this place leaves a lot to the imagination. The lobby does not run air conditioning in the summer, and the staff and guests are sweating while working to get their rooms. It was also the one and only time I've been in Japan, and received condescending service. The worst part of it all - beds. Sure, there's more room under the bed now…

1022.a: Japan, 〒638-0431 Nara, Yoshino District, Tenkawa, Dorogawa, 522 柿の葉寿司 柳豊
1022.aj: 〒638-0431 奈良県吉野郡天川村洞川５２２ 柿の葉寿司 柳豊
1022.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Kakinoha sushi, especially the mackerel and salmon varieties, noting the perfect balance of saltiness and vinegared rice. They also highlight the warm and attentive service from the staff, who offer tea and sweets while guests wait. Others appreciate the option to dine in or take out, and the availability of seasonal sushi and other local products.
1022.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、柿の葉寿司の美味しさを高く評価しています。特に、サバとサケの柿の葉寿司は、塩味と酢飯のバランスが絶妙で美味しいというクチコミが多くあります。また、スタッフの温かく丁寧なサービスも評判のようです。ゲストが待っている間にお茶やお菓子を提供してくれるという声もあります。店内での飲食だけでなく、テイクアウトもできる点や、季節限定の寿司や地元の特産品が手に入る点も喜ばれています。

rv.t: A Nice restarant where they serve traditionally leaf-wrapped mackrel sushi, which is very tasty and fresh, despite being very far from major supply lines.

奈良県天川村・洞川温泉街にある「柿の葉寿司 柳豊」は、吉野・天川エリアを訪れた際にぜひ立ち寄りたい名店です。奈良の郷土料理である柿の葉寿司を手軽に味わえるお店で、温泉街の散策途中に購入して食べるのにもぴったりです。 今回いただいた柿の葉寿司は、柿の葉の爽やかな香りと程よく締まったネタの旨味が絶妙に調和していて、とても美味しかったです。特に鯖は脂の乗りが良く、それでいてしつこさがなく、酢飯との相性も抜群でした。口に入れた瞬間に柿の葉の香りがふわっと広がり、奈良ならではの味わいを存分に楽しめます。昔ながらの製法を大切にしていることが伝わってくる素朴で上品な味でした。 お店の方の対応も温かく、観光客にも親切に接してくださるのが印象的でした。商品の説明も丁寧で、初めて柿の葉寿司を食べる人でも安心して購入できます。店内にはどこか懐かしい雰囲気が漂い、洞川温泉の風情ある街並みによく溶け込んでいます。…

この村で人気の柿の葉寿司店。 お寿司は、まさに「天川の水の美しさ」をどこか感じさせる瑞々しさといいますか、雑味のない清らかなイメージがあります。海から遠い山間の村でありながら、いえ、山間の村だからこそ磨かれたのかもしれないですね。女将曰く、柿の葉寿司の美味い不味いはハッキリ意見が分かれるのだとか。 村の清流を眺めながら、一貫、また一貫と口に運ぶたびに幸福感は積もっていきます。「あぁ何個でも食べたい」と思ったときにはもう寿司を開いたあとの柿の葉しか手元にありませんでした。おかわりを買いに行ったくらいです（笑） お米は一粒ひとつぶが立っており、ネタの旨味を優しく、かつ力強く引き立てています。派手な飾り立てはなくとも、素材の持ち味を最大限に活かした丁寧な仕事ぶりは、まさに「実直」という言葉がふさわしい仕上がりです。

1022.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:30

1023.a: Nakai Shunpudo, 545 Yoshinoyama, Yoshino, Yoshino District, Nara 639-3115, Japan
1023.aj: 〒639-3115 奈良県吉野郡吉野町吉野山５４５ 葛屋 中井春風堂(吉野本葛菓子専門店)
1023.ed: Snug shop offering kudzu-based confections such as kuzukiri & kuzumochi, plus live demonstrations.
1023.edj: 葛切りや葛もちなどの葛菓子を提供する、落ち着いた雰囲気の店。店頭で菓子が出来上がる過程を見ることができる。

rv.t: A fantastic experience. The kuzu dessert is prepared fresh when you order (10-20 mins). You can watch a live demonstration to see how your dessert is made. It is in Japanese but the chef will repeat key sentences in English.

作りたての葛餅が食べられるとの事で二人で訪問。 平日で空いていました。 予約すると15分後までにはお店に戻って来てくださいとの事でそのまま店内で待たせていただきました。 店内には店主さんの趣味というプラモデルなどが飾ってあって面白かったです。 メニューは葛切りと葛餅で、二人で1つずつ注文したら半分ずつお皿に盛り付けますよ、とお店の方が言ってくださったので両方を半分ずついただくことが出来ました。 葛切りはポン酢で食べるとお鍋のマロニ〇みたい。ポン酢で食べるのが気に入りました。 葛餅は葛切りよりやわからく、黒みつときなこで。とても美味しかったです。 吉野旅ではじめに入ったのがこちらのお店で、この後3店舗で葛菓子を食べましたがここの出来たてが1番美味しかった。 お土産用に買った葛まんじゅうも好評でした。
2026.1.2 吉野本葛切りをいただきたした。 綺麗に透き通った葛切りは弾力あり とっても美味しい！ 甘さ控えめの黒蜜もきな粉も絶品でした。 店員さんがとても親切で 奈良の方は親切な方が多いですね。

1023.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1024.a: Traditional Local Food Yumeichi-chaya, １５４−３ 154-3 Shimasho, Asuka, Takaichi District, Nara 634-0112, Japan
1024.aj: 〒634-0112 奈良県高市郡明日香村島庄１５４−３ １５４−３ 農村レストラン 夢市茶屋
1024.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious ancient rice dishes, including flavorful curries and hearty set meals featuring local vegetables and tender fried chicken. They also highlight the reasonable prices, pleasant views, and convenient location near tourist attractions. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
1024.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、古代米を使った美味しい料理を高く評価しています。風味豊かなカレーや、地元の野菜と柔らかい唐揚げが特徴のボリューム満点な定食などがあり、リーズナブルな価格も魅力のようです。また、心地よい景色と観光地に近い便利な立地も好評です。 一部のクチコミでは、サービスがあまり良くないという意見もあります。

rv.t: Wonderful place to have lunch near this area. Their ancient rice and tofu were especially delicious
Authentic local restaurant. Authentic local food. The tea was hot and the beer was cold. Paradise.

Great healthy lunches that use local products just a few meters from the Ishibutai Tomb. Had the 古代米の御前(Ancient Rice Meal) which had seasonal dishes with black rice. Not much to chose from locally, but it has great dishes, endless tea, and strong air conditioning.

1024.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1025.aj: 〒633-2115 奈良県宇陀市大宇陀西山３ 森野吉野葛本舗 葛の館

rv.t: 吉野といえば葛ということで昼過ぎに行って来ました。 コロプラのコロカ提携店ですね、久しぶりの来店です。 葛粉や葛湯の販売スペースの隣に葛スイーツを楽しめる喫茶スペースがあります。 葛湯、葛もち、本蕨もち、葛きりを注文しました。 すべて注文を受けてからつくられます、3人の店員さんが鍋に火をかけコンコンと葛を練りあげてくれてる音がします。 葛湯はあつあつ、葛もちと本蕨もちはきな粉でそれぞれの味と食感を楽しむ、葛きりは黒蜜でツルツル。 葛を堪能した最高の午後でした。

宇陀市の人気観光スポット『宇陀松山』近くにある『葛の館 茶房 葛味庵』で賞味期限3分の生珈琲葛饅頭と本蕨もちが現れた👾 . . オーダーしてから作られる葛スイーツがどれも絶品😍何度か伺っているので今回は初めて頂くメニューをオーダー♡賞味期限3分って所に心ときめいた『生珈琲葛饅頭』をチョイス👾 . . トロットロの葛の中から珈琲餡が登場♪葛の風味と珈琲がめちゃくちゃ合って、とっても美味しかった😍やはりなんとも言えない口当たりからの口溶け...本当に癖になる美味しさです👾 . . トゥルントゥルンの本蕨に心地よい風味のきな粉が、これまた最高に美味しい😍こちらの葛は風味口当たり口溶けどれも好みすぎる👾笑
これぞ本物！手作り出来たての葛餅は柔らかくトロトロモチモチ食感！！本葛なのでそれなりの価格はするが喉越しも良く1度ぐらいは食べてみるべき逸品ではある！

1025.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

1026.a: Mendoya, 40 Oka, Asuka, Takaichi District, Nara 634-0111, Japan
1026.aj: 〒634-0111 奈良県高市郡明日香村岡４０ めんどや
1026.ed: Diners like this restaurant's flavorful and hearty dishes, especially the generously portioned nyumen noodles and homemade Kakinoha sushi. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the wide variety of local ingredients used. Guests mention the staff are friendly and attentive, and appreciate the availability of an English menu.
1026.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、風味豊かでボリュームのある料理を高く評価しています。特に、たっぷりのにゅうめんや自家製柿の葉寿司が好評です。手頃な価格と、地元の食材を豊富に使っている点も特徴です。スタッフは親しみやすく、きめ細やかな対応をしてくれるという声があり、英語のメニューがあることも喜ばれています。

rv.t: I love this place. Everything was so good. The service was great. But the food tasted so fresh, so yummy. I love the “spongey” elements in our dishes like you bite into something and it’s like sponge oozing with flavors. Presentation was so colorful and classy as well. They are also nice to have an English menu ready for those who cannot speak Japanese. I 100% recommend this restaurant!

The asuka nabe (Hot pot) set was 3850 yens per person during lunch. The hot pot alone without the side dishes, 2950 yens per person. The set was alot of food. Did not want to disrespect so gave it our best shot to finish the food. Ate so much, had to skip dinner. The broth had a light umanmi flavor at the beginning but intensified as the broth reduced over the course of the meal. What were in the hot pot... chicken…

Lovely place and a homely atmosphere. The lady was very kind and happy to accommodate my dietary requests. The food was very delicious. Highly recommended if you're around. Parking is available. Would love to drop by again.

1026.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00（土）

1027.a: Japan, 〒638-0431 Nara, Yoshino District, Tenkawa, Dorogawa, ４７ 味処 きらく九兵衛
1027.aj: 〒638-0431 奈良県吉野郡天川村洞川４７ 味処 きらく九兵衛
1027.ed: Diners like this restaurant's generous portions of delicious Japanese set meals, including tempura and grilled river fish, as well as hearty hot pot udon and mehari sushi. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the relaxing atmosphere with scenic river views. Others also mention the spotless restrooms and the attentive staff.
1027.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、天ぷらや川魚の塩焼きなど、ボリュームたっぷりの美味しい和食の定食を高く評価しています。また、鍋焼きうどんやめはり寿司も評判のようです。手頃な価格で、川の景色を眺めながらリラックスできる雰囲気も特徴として挙げられています。その他、清潔なトイレや、気の利くスタッフについてのクチコミも多くあります。

rv.t: The food here is flavorful. Tried their curry soba and it really nice! Not too spicy and warms the tummy. The tamago is a must too and so is the pork katsu. Nice!
Nice soba noodle and tempura for lunch! This restaurant is located by the river so has a nice view out of windows.

定食が食べれる様なお食事処が少ないので、 お席につくまでは結構待ちました。 待つ椅子は店内にもお店の外にもあるので座って待てました。 天ざる定食に単品のあまごの塩焼きと 天ぷら定食をいただきました。 天ぷら定食も天ざるも天ぷらのボリュームがすごくて かなりお腹いっぱいになりました✨✨ そしてサクサクでとっても美味しかったです。 雨でしたが、 店内からは川が見えるので お食事中も景色が楽しめました。 川のお水がとっても綺麗で、 お魚が見えるほどでした。

1027.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1028.a: Japan, 〒630-8221 Nara, Ganriincho, 19 鰻屋 梅鉢
1028.aj: 〒630-8221 奈良県奈良市元林院町１９ 鰻屋 梅鉢
1028.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious unagi, noting its crispy skin and fluffy texture, with many highlighting the flavorful sauce and generous portions. They also appreciate the traditional Japanese house setting, which offers a quiet and charming atmosphere. Guests mention the staff are attentive, polite, and provide excellent service, with some noting English-speaking staff are available.
1028.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、美味しい鰻を高く評価しています。皮はパリッと香ばしく、身はふっくらとした食感が特徴で、多くの人が風味豊かなタレとボリュームのある量に満足しているようです。また、伝統的な日本家屋の落ち着いた雰囲気も好評です。静かで趣のある空間で食事ができるという声が多くあります。スタッフは気配りができて丁寧で、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているというクチコミがあり、中には英語を話せるスタッフがいるという情報もあります。

rv.t: A nice find wedged inbetween houses for an alley just behind Starbucks or next to depending on your sense of direction It's build into what feels like a traditional Japanese house giving a nice homely feel. When entering without reservation you can ring a doorbell at the entrance.( Applies to reservations as well me think) You can keep your shoes on, no need to remove them since that was my first instinct. Someone…

I had a lovely dinner at 鰻屋 梅鉢 in Nara. It is a charming eel restaurant set inside an old Japanese residential building, which gives the place a quiet, traditional atmosphere. The wooden structure and low crossbeams add a lot of character, though taller guests may need to mind their head. The eel set was delicious, with a rich grilled aroma and a comforting, well-balanced presentation. The staff were also very…

Unagi is one of my favorite foods. I’ve had it at various places in Tokyo, Osaka, and the US. This is by far among the best I’ve had. The restaurant is in a beautiful, historic building. Can’t recommend it highly enough.

1028.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1029.a: Kakinohazushi Yamato, 719-1 Kurozaki, Sakurai, Nara 633-0011, Japan
1029.aj: 〒633-0011 奈良県桜井市黒崎７１９−１ 柿の葉ずしヤマト 桜井店

rv.t: 奈良に来たし柿の葉寿司を食べたいなと思い長谷寺までの道中に寄らせて頂きました。 柿の葉寿司はもちろん、焼き鯖押し寿司やちらし寿司がとても美味しかったです。 頼んでから作るようで少し待ちました。 お茶を飲んで待つスペースがありますが食事はできません。 テイクアウト専門のお店のようでしたが、外にちょっぴりある椅子とテーブルでは食事しても大丈夫とのことでそこで頂きました。 入り口には燕の巣があり子育て中のようでした。 お店の方はみなさん優しく、とても心地よいお店でした。
10年ぶり位に購入しました。 以前は味付けが好きで奈良に行った時は近くの店に寄って購入していました、 今回、久しぶりに食べると、鮭の寿司のネタが薄くなってペラペラ。 多少値上げしても品質を保って欲しかったです。 好きな柿の葉寿司だったので非常に残念。
全て美味しかったですが、おススメはサバとサケ。穴子も美味しかったです。これは手土産で持っていったら喜ばれますね。時間はかかるものの注文してから作ってくれるのも好印象です。

1030.a: Izasa-Nakatani-hompo Yumekaze-hiroba, 東大寺門前夢風ひろば 内 16 Kasuganocho, Nara, 630-8212, Japan
1030.aj: 〒630-8212 奈良県奈良市春日野町１６ 内 東大寺門前夢風ひろば ゐざさ 大和吉野 柿の葉寿司 東大寺門前夢風ひろば店
1030.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Kakinoha sushi, somen, and udon, as well as the wide variety of traditional Japanese dishes. They also highlight the reasonable prices, generous portions, and top-notch service. Guests mention the pleasant atmosphere and the beautiful views of Todaiji Temple from the window seats.
1030.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、柿の葉寿司やそうめん、うどんなどの伝統的な日本料理を高く評価しています。手頃な価格で量が多く、サービスも素晴らしいというクチコミが多くあります。また、店内の雰囲気も良く、窓側の席からは東大寺の美しい景色が見えるという感想もあります。

rv.t: TLDR: worth trying! Their sushi wrapped in persimmon leaves is very interesting. I’m not a big fan of the taste but it’s definitely worth trying, since it’s unlike any other that I’ve tried. They also have “tofu” that’s made of mung beans, which has a unique texture. You can also takeaway. Their collab takeaway sets are very cute! Top-notch service! The staff were polite and it’s worth the price point. It does get a…
Had such a lovely experience trying Nara’s local delicacies here. The kakinoha sushi was surprisingly refreshing. Paired it with somen and udon! The combination was simple yet so yummy!

Tried Izasa Honpo after visiting Todaiji and it was such a comforting meal. The steamed chirashi sushi with eel, salmon and shrimp was warm and flavourful with light crisp tempura on the side. The set with assorted sushi, soumen and sesame tofu was delicate and satisfying. The salmon pressed sushi wrapped in persimmon leaves was simple with a lovely aroma. A friendly chat with the staff made the visit even sweeter…

1030.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1031.a: Tanakakakinohasushihonpo Honten, 1 Chome-1-15 Shinmachi, Gojo, Nara 637-0043, Japan
1031.aj: 〒637-0043 奈良県五條市新町１丁目１−１５ 柿の葉すし本舗たなか 五條本店

rv.t: Excellent persimmon leaf sushi. I bought the mixed box and demolished it all in my car, forgetting to take a photo. Now I’m always on the hunt for more persimmon leaf sushi. Definitely drop by if you’re in the area and give it a try!

柿の葉すし 本当に美味しいです大好きです 今日も大阪からの仕事帰りの新幹線で 柿の葉すし と ビールで楽しませて いただきました 基本のさば と さけ 私は柿の葉の香りを楽しみながらの 締めた さば が大好きです 柿の葉すし を食べたのが かれこれ20年その前かも 終電に近い新幹線 弁当売り場には 残りわずかのお弁当が その時もビールと共に購入し 腹の減った体に ビールを流し込み どうやって開けるのと（今も少し開けづらいです）箱を開けると 上品な柿の葉に包まれた すしが あの時も 今も変わらず 大正解 美味しい時には 言葉が出ませんね！ 本舗たなか 五條本店 には なかなか行くことがございませんが いつかは本店に行ってみたいと思いながら また大阪での仕事の時は 買って帰るでしょう 👍️

奈良名物の柿の葉寿司を購入するため、 ｢柿の葉すし本舗たなか 五條本店｣へ 【7個入 さば､さけ】 海のない吉野地方では、防腐効果のある柿の葉で包むことで寿司の乾燥を防いでいました。 鯖と鮭の両方を味わえる2種 7個入を注文。 さけは脂がそこまで強くないからあっさりめ。 酢飯の酸味とちょうどいいバランス。 対してさばは脂のコクがしっかりあって、 噛むほどに旨みが出てきます。 酢で締めてあるから重すぎず、 でも味は濃いめで満足感あります。 また奈良に来た時は買おうと思います。 ごちそうさまでした。

1032.a: Japan, 〒639-3113 Nara, Yoshino District, 吉野郡Hirasou Yoshino Honten, 吉野町 飯貝６１４
1032.aj: 〒639-3113 奈良県吉野郡平宗 吉野本店 吉野町 飯貝６１４
1032.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious kakinoha sushi and ayu sushi, especially the grilled mackerel sushi. They also highlight the calm atmosphere and the beautiful views of Yoshino from the dining area. Guests mention the convenient parking and the option to take out food.
1032.edj: このレストランを訪れた人は、柿の葉寿司や鮎寿司、特に焼き鯖寿司が美味しいと評価しています。落ち着いた雰囲気や、食事をしながら吉野の美しい景色を眺められる点も高く評価されています。また、駐車場が利用しやすいことや、テイクアウトができることについても言及されています。

rv.t: We take a platter for 3 persons & two type of mackerel grilled & roasted so delicious. Not allowed to take away leftovers and no sauces or wasabi given but so delicious nothing needed just savour the authentic taste of the sushi 👍🏻 will definitely go again on my next visit to Japan

Perfect place to eat after hanami! I found this place last year and visit everytime I’m in the area. Just an hour by Shinkansen from where I live now, but it is one of many things that I look forward to when in Nara. Does get crowded this time of year due to tourists.

Deliciously wrapped in fragrant persimmon leaves Yoshino's unique sushi was a flavor experience! Expertly prepared with pride in the local culinary heritage. The warm hospitality made the experience even sweeter. A must-try taste of the region's incredible food culture. We'll happily return for more!

1033.a: Comfy - Japanese Café & Bar, 6-2 Nishiterabayashicho, Nara, 630-8372, Japan
1033.aj: 〒630-8372 奈良県奈良市西寺林町６−２ 和食cafe＆bar Comfy
1033.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious Japanese cuisine, which features fresh, local, and seasonal ingredients, with many highlighting the tasting plates and set menus. They also appreciate the calm and welcoming atmosphere, along with the friendly and attentive staff, many of whom speak English. Guests mention the reasonable prices and recommend making reservations, especially on weekends.
1033.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、新鮮な地元の旬の食材を使い、会席料理や定食が特徴の美味しい和食を高く評価しています。また、落ち着いた居心地の良い雰囲気や、親切で丁寧なスタッフも好評で、英語を話せるスタッフも多いというクチコミがあります。価格は手頃で、特に週末は予約することをおすすめする声が多くあります。

rv.t: 10/10 expérience, this restaurant is really really cute. Loved the atmosphere, the owner and the chef are really friendly and welcoming. The food is excellent i highly recommend the fried fish and the miso soup was definitely the best one i had in my life. Thank you so much for everything it was so perfect for our first meal in Nara. And thank you for making us discover and try sake from Nara :)

If you are looking for a wonderful restaurant in Nara as a traveler, then look no further! Incredible Locally sourced authentic Nara food. The owner was very pleasant and friendly and speaks great English. He explained that he gets all of the ingredients from the Nara farms. We ordered many dishes for the 4 of us and each item was meticulously crafted and delicious. We loved the potatoes, the set menu, the sashimi…

We had our best experience of Nara at this place. Food was amazing, veggies straight from the local farm. The owner is very friendly and hospitable, we had a great conversation and he even recommended us local sake brand, which tasted wonderful! Undoubtably recommend this restaurant to everyone visiting Nara ;)

1034.ed: Airy room with floor & table seating, for set meals with beef or seafood, plus kakigori shaved ice.
1034.edj: 座敷とテーブル席のある明るく広々としたレストラン。牛や魚介の定食を味わえる。

rv.t: A Must-Visit Dining Experience in Nara! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ One of the best meals we had during our trip to Japan! The Gyū-mabushi was absolutely delicious, and every bite was full of flavor. We ordered the Signature Triple Mabushi, which allowed us to enjoy three different types of meat, each perfectly cooked and incredibly tender. The unique four-step way of enjoying the meal made the experience even more memorable—from tasting…

We are a group of 10 and we have eaten separately in 6 and 4, something very normal in all the restaurants we have eaten. very good service and very good food, even the small version is great. the service very nice and very attentive, the boy who has attended us at the beginning is very kind, we are from Spain and has spoken a little Spanish with us, has also named us players of our local team, very funny. Is…

Gyumsbushi Miyama is a cosy restaurant on the corner of the main road close to the Todaji Temple at Nara. Very limited menu as it specialises in Gyu Mabushi set which is served with beef or pork for non vegetarians and soya bean for vegetarians. It also has instructions on the table on how to enjoy the meal.They have an English menu. The staff were very friendly and service was quick. Thankfully there was no queue…

1034.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00（土）

1035.aj: 〒630-8241 奈良県奈良市高天町４４−５ 水餃子W
1035.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious pan-fried and boiled dumplings, with many highlighting the juicy, flavorful fillings and chewy skins. They also mention the tasty side dishes, especially the spicy poached chicken and marinated dried tofu. Guests appreciate the friendly staff and the cozy, relaxed atmosphere.
1035.edj: この中華料理店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しい焼き餃子と水餃子が高く評価されています。特に、ジューシーで風味豊かな餡と、もちもちとした皮を挙げる人が多くいます。また、美味しいサイドメニューも評判のようで、特にスパイシーなよだれ鶏と干し豆腐の和え物がおすすめとして挙げられています。スタッフの対応も親しみやすく、居心地の良いリラックスした雰囲気を気に入ったという声もあります。

rv.t: We loved the dumplings. Even though they forgot to bring the meat and the rice at the same time they compensated it with offering us chicken, which was really tasty thank you very much. Nice place to enjoy mandarin cuisine.

Tucked in a cute alley near Nara Station, you can get an amazing lunch here! Everything was a hit! We got the “mouth watering” chicken, red chili chicken stir fry, and pork dumplings. Dumplings were made in-house 😍 Be aware the red chili chicken is spiced with Szechuan - so get ready for some fireworks in your mouth!
Amazing place, it's not really big so go early. You can choose from a tablet and you have lots of choices. I absolutely recommend the dumplings, really tasty. Great staff and good prices.

Too good to be true.....we found our Kyoto in Nara. We polished every morsel. The hosts are brilliant. We drank well, ate
Good food in a convenient location. Has amazing staff working there who speak fantastic English and are extremely friendly.

1037.a: SARASA - Yamato Tea Café, 6-1 Kunodocho, Nara, 630-8382, Japan
1037.aj: 〒630-8382 奈良県奈良市公納堂町６−１ 大和茶カフェ 茶樂茶 SARASA
1037.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious matcha lattes, purple sweet potato desserts, and charcoal-grilled mitarashi dango, which they can cook to their liking. They also highlight the elegant and calm atmosphere, noting it's a great place to relax. Guests mention the staff are very kind, attentive, and provide excellent service.
1037.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しい抹茶ラテや紫芋のデザート、そして自分で焼くことができる炭火焼きのみたらし団子が高く評価されています。また、上品で落ち着いた雰囲気が特徴で、リラックスするのに最適な場所という声が多くあります。スタッフはとても親切で気配りができ、素晴らしいサービスを提供しているという感想が多く寄せられています。

rv.t: The dessert is definitely a bit overpriced They don’t control the temperature of purple sweet potato well. The surface of the dessert doesn’t have good texture Moreover, the core, which is Sponge cake, is totally disaster. It’s super tough and hard and dry… couldn’t really taste the true flavor of it. The best thing in this dessert is the Horjicha jelly, it’s super creamy and enlightening. This part makes you feel…

It's like finding a hidden gem. The first floor table was full so we were able to go upstairs. It's a traditional japanese tea room where we had roasted tea and charcoal grilled gluten rice ball which was amazing. They also sold Nara made tea whisk.
Beautiful cafe. Felt like a true fine dining experience. My matcha latte was amazing. Take some time to stop in here on your next visit to Nara!

1037.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00（土）

1038.a: Japan, 〒630-8301 Nara, Takabatakecho, 1116-6 CAFE & BAR MIROKU TERRACE
1038.aj: 〒630-8301 奈良県奈良市高畑町１１１６−６ CAFE & BAR MIROKU TERRACE

rv.t: Spacious cafe with both indoor and outdoor seating. The design is simple and clean. It was pretty busy when I visited, but luckily I still got a table without waiting. The staff were friendly and helpful. The menu is fairly basic. The ice cream was good, while the drinks were just okay, nothing that really stood out. It's close to Nara Park, so it's an easy stop if you're nearby. Personally, I'd probably try a…
10/10 cafe near Nara Park. Staff was super nice and my iced matcha was the best I’ve had so far on my Japan trip. Affogato ice cream and white wine was great too.

Some places have a way of capturing your heart, and this café is truly one of them. From the charming tree filled ambiance to the excellent service, every detail here is simply wonderful. I love everything about it! If you’re looking for a cozy spot to enjoy a drink and unwind, I highly recommend this place 🍀🍀

1038.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1039.aj: 〒630-8372 奈良県奈良市西寺林町５ kinari pizza
1039.ed: Informal food truck with down-to-earth garden seating & a menu focused on pizza & creative drinks.
1039.edj: ピザやオリジナル ドリンクを提供するカジュアルなキッチンカー。落ち着いた雰囲気の庭にテーブル席がある。

rv.t: Worth the wait. The kids loved the pizza. The pale ale was delicious. Seating area in the back was cozy. Salame, funghi and Bismarck were all great. I couldn’t decide which was best. If you can tolerate some heat, their pepper sauce was delicious. It had a flavorful kick.

A soft five stars ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ pizza 🍕 What do we mean by soft 5 stars pizza? It is very nice, tasty and recommended, but not exuisite. Settings: they baked the pizza in a truck and you seat in their yard (casual dining, not fancy). However: the italian craft cola is amazing. As good as Iyoshi cola.

We had to wait almost 30m for a table. The waitress qas very kind and polite and once we sat down, the pizza arrived in 10 minutes. It was very tasty. The crust was thin and easy to cut it with fork and knife. I recommend the place if you don't mind waiting in line.

1039.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00（土）

1040.a: Take no Yakata, 25 Minamiuoyacho, Nara, 630-8355, Japan
1040.aj: 〒630-8355 奈良県奈良市南魚屋町２５ 竹の館
1040.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and generously sized oden, with many highlighting the deeply flavorful broth and popular items like daikon, egg, and octopus. They also mention the reasonable prices and the nostalgic, lively atmosphere. Guests appreciate the simple menu and the fluffy, large onigiri, which are perfect for finishing a meal.
1040.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、美味しくてボリュームのあるおでんを高く評価しています。特に、出汁がしっかり染み込んだ深い味わいのつゆや、大根、卵、タコといった人気具材を挙げるクチコミが多くあります。また、手頃な価格設定や、懐かしく活気のある雰囲気も好評のようです。シンプルなメニュー構成や、ふわふわで大きなおにぎりも、食事の締めくくりにぴったりだと喜ばれています。

rv.t: Traditional oden shop with a lot of choice for a perfect winter meal. The rolled cabbage was delicious, daikon super chunky, the mustard had a pleasant kick. We paid ¥5000 for 2 adults and 2 kids.
Bar seating no longer available (a post-COVID thing perhaps?) and the place felt different from what it used to be (also a change in management?) :')

Found one traditional shop who serving Japanese Oden in Nara. Old school shop and full with bamboo deco but running by young owners. The owners quickly bring us to a table and show us with English menu when he knows we are tourists. Highly recommended their rice balls and Oden - beef cut, braised radish, rolled cabbage & tofu rice cake. They also serving Chazuke. Should try it if I happen to visit next round.

1040.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 17:00

1041.a: Todai-ji Daibutsuden (Great Buddha Hall), 406-1 Zoshicho, Nara, 630-8587, Japan
1041.aj: 〒630-8587 奈良県奈良市雑司町４０６−１ 東大寺大仏殿
1041.ed: Historic Buddhist temple featuring a large Buddha statue & deer roaming the grounds.
1041.edj: 由緒ある仏教寺院。大仏と境内に棲む鹿が有名。

rv.t: Our visit to Tōdai-ji Temple in Nara was unforgettable, especially because of the massive Great Buddha statue inside its impressive main hall. The temple is surrounded by a beautiful green park full of free-roaming deer and is close to local museums and art galleries, making it a perfect mix of nature and culture. You can also choose between a standard temple entry ticket or a combo ticket that includes the museum…

Visiting Todai-ji Daibutsuden was truly one of the most awe-inspiring experiences of my trip to Japan. From the moment I approached the massive wooden structure, I was struck by its sheer scale and presence. It’s hard to believe that this is one of the largest wooden buildings in the world—the craftsmanship and architectural detail are simply breathtaking. Inside, the Great Buddha statue leaves you speechless. The…
Temple statues mystical and you have to see while you are in Nara. Buddhist Temple charms museum the temple must must must see we loved it .

1042.aj: 〒630-8587 奈良県奈良市雑司町４０６−１ 東大寺
1042.ed: Buddhist temple originally built in the mid-700s, with one of Japan's largest bronze Buddha statues.
1042.edj: 8 世紀中頃に建立された寺院。日本最大級の青銅製の大仏があることで知られる。

rv.t: Visited Tōdai-ji Temple in Nara and experience was truly remarkable. The temple grounds are majestic and full of history, with the Great Buddha Hall being the highlight. Seeing the enormous bronze Buddha statue was awe-inspiring and left a lasting impression on both adults and children. The atmosphere is peaceful despite the popularity of the site, and the surrounding area with friendly deer roaming freely added a…

When we arrived in Hara I thought I was Templed and Shrined out but of all the temples we visited this was probably the most impressive. It is a huge wooden structure that in itself is incredibly impressive but the huge Buddhas and associated sculptures are extraordinary. Honestly worth a visit especially as you go through the amazing deer park to get there!

Absolutely breathtaking. Tōdai-ji is an enormous wooden temple, beautifully decorated inside and home to the spectacular Great Buddha. The scale of both the building and the statue is truly impressive. Children will especially enjoy crawling through the small hole at the bottom of one of the wooden pillars. It is said to be the same size as the Great Buddha’s nostril, and tradition says that anyone who manages to…

1043.a: Heijokyorajomonato Park, 5 Chome Saikujocho, Nara, 630-8453, Japan
1043.aj: 〒630-8453 奈良県奈良市西九条町５丁目 平城京羅城門跡公園

rv.t: 羅城門橋を作った時に残った空地を公園にしたのだろうか?しかし、公園は手入れがなされておらず、もったいない感がある。公園、内部通路の草は伸び放題だし、樹木についても剪定が必要である。立地について目の前には、イオンモール大和郡山があるのは間違いないが、駅からは遠いし、更に駐車する場所が無い。面積も中途半端である。また道路とは高低差があることから、土地の活用の仕方は困難かも知れない。公園には石に彫られた歌碑があるが、面白みがない。いっそのこと、アスファルトやセメントで土地を舗装すれば雑草が生えない。
歴史で平城京を習うと必ず羅城門や朱雀門の話が出てきます。ここが平城京の南の端でいかに大きかったのかが分かります。それにしても公園は荒れ果てて見捨てられた感じがします。交流があった小学校が植樹したプレートなどが割れたまなっているのを見ていると悲しい気持ちになります。せめて公園の名前くらいはハッキリ表示すべきでしょう。
お婆ちゃんと子供２人を連れて行きましたが、快適に過ごせました 施設内は清潔で冷房も効いていました 丸1日過ごせました

1044.a: Japan, 〒639-1031 Nara, Yamatokoriyama, Imagoucho, 123-13 ニコニコレンタカー 大和郡山今国府店
1044.aj: 〒639-1031 奈良県大和郡山市今国府町１２３−１３ ニコニコレンタカー 大和郡山今国府店

1045.a: Nikusho Gyuko Nishinakajima, B1 4 Chome-3-21 Nishinakajima, Yodogawa Ward, Osaka, 532-0011, Japan
1045.aj: 〒532-0011 大阪府大阪市淀川区西中島４丁目３−２１ B1 肉匠 牛虎 西中島店
1045.ed: Diners like this yakiniku restaurant's delicious and tender meats, especially the harami, beef tongue, and yukke, and appreciate the variety of lunch sets available. They also highlight the reasonable prices and the clean, stylish atmosphere with private seating options. Guests mention the staff provides attentive and kind service, even accommodating late arrivals.
1045.edj: この焼肉店を利用した人は、美味しくて柔らかい肉、特にハラミ、牛タン、ユッケを高く評価しています。ランチセットの種類が豊富な点も好評です。また、手頃な価格設定や、清潔でおしゃれな雰囲気、個室があることも特徴として挙げられています。スタッフは丁寧で親切なサービスを提供し、閉店間際の来店にも対応してくれるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Thank you for good food. Good meats. We arrived at about 2.20pm, almost 10 minutes before their last order timing. And they still accommodated us and allowed us to order and lunch.
The service was incredible, the staff were so helpful and respectful. They took their time explaining the menu to us as our japanese is not so good. The meal was also delicious to top it off.
We do enjoy the beef especially the beef tounge

rv.t: Absolutely loved this hidden gem of an izakaya! The vibe is fantastic, with a cozy and charming ambiance that makes you feel right at home. It’s run by a talented male chef and a super friendly lady who made our experience even more enjoyable. The food? Incredible! They specialize in Yakitori skewers that are perfectly grilled, but don’t stop there—the other dishes are just as amazing. Everything we tried was…
Very nice local lzakaya where we went for dinner in Sapporo. The food was perfect and the staff was friendly.
Very cozy and warm place to get Yakitori. 5 star for food and service♥️

1047.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious coffee, a wide variety of pastries like tiramisu and Basque cheesecake, and hearty brunch options. Visitors also highlight the spacious, comfortable atmosphere in a beautifully renovated old building, and the clean restrooms. Some reviews mention the food can be overpriced.

rv.t: The cafe has a nice industrial design which compliments the ambiance of a chill coffee place. The staff are friendly and accommodating. We came here for the coffee and the coffee is nice but is not distinct from other cafes. The tuna sandwich is simple but taste is ok. The cafe is on the 2nd floor so it’s not accessible for people with disabilities.

I think this place is overrated. Yes, it LOOKS stylish, both the building and the food. But firstly, due to the high ceilings and no proper wall treatment that would absorb the sound, it's super noisy (I'm a drummer, so I'm not THAT sensitive but it was too much, even for me). The staff is not exactly unfriendly but somewhat indifferent, so it's not particularly fun to interact with them. The food is overpriced-…

rv.t: Great information and insights about the nature and insect/animal lives on Mount Takao before or after your hike. Exhibits are beautifully presented and the space is nicely illuminated with ample sunlight entering the space. There is a cozy cafe inside the museum with great coffee. Air conditioning is comfortable and there are seats around for you to just take a rest.

I really enjoyed this small, free, very modern looking museum. Displays of the different types of animals that can be found on Mount Takao. Cases filled with different insects. A short video presentation on the hour. One small stamp at the entryway.

Such an amazing project of education, art, design and understanding of nature. The museum is lovely and absolutely a must. It’s very close to the station so I suggest to visit as soon as you arrive. rv.t: I was here a few hours before my visit to the Ghibli Museum which is on the other side of the Inokashira park. It was a cloudy day and was going to rain in a few minutes so it was a bit chilly. I was craving something warm and comforting when I came across this little hole in the wall looking cafe that was selling CHAI in the middle of Tokyo! I was so excited to try this despite my husband warning me that it might…

The best chai I've had in Tokyo (so far)! 😋 Located right next to Inokashira Park, Chai Break is a really good place to relax in. During my visit, I ordered their original chai latte (masala chai) and it definitely didn't dissapoint. Unlike the usual chai lattes served in Tokyo, this one had a very nice balance of flavor and wasn't too sweet 🥰 Furthermore, the chai they used didn't taste artificial at all. If you…
Their chai is good , more on the milky side I liked their hearty french soup with vegetables Its more on the pricey side but food and service is good 👍

1050.ed: Stylish rooms in a vintage-style hotel offering a Japanese pub & an outdoor pool, plus free Wi-Fi.
1050.edj: スタイリッシュな客室を備えたヴィンテージ調のホテル。日本の居酒屋メニューを提供するパブ、屋外プール、無料 Wi-Fi を完備。

rv.t: This hotel is the best, the staff is extremely helpful, great rooms, really convenient for concerts and all the things happening around Fenway. The parking is a highway ripoff, but that's not a complaint of The Verb, it's just what the market is. But $73 to park a car for a night is ridiculous, There are garages for a fraction of that across the street.

We really enjoyed this hotel! The room had a fan in addition to good air conditioning. There was also a turn table in the room and a large selection of albums in the lobby. The lobby also had cold and hot brew coffee on tap 24/7 as well as bottled water. The breakfast selection included all the basic grab and go stuff with the option for made to order waffles and fruit smoothies. It was walking distance to Fenway…

Had an outing at Fenway and needed to book a room for 1 night. Booked The Verb for its proximity, and I was very impressed with the hotel! The pictures don’t do it justice! Wonderful place, wonderful staff! Not a large place and not a spacious entrance, but it gets the job done and they made great use of every inch! The rooms are decent sized and we LOVED the theming throughout! Just my opinion, but room 246 was the…

rv.t: Very cute cookie cafe. Each person must order a drink as well as a cookie/pastry. We tried the croissant/cookie, stuffed cookies and the New York roll. All good. The stand out was the cream cheese matcha cookie.

Very cute cookies in Harajuku area. Tasty and cute holiday designs. Is a bit expensive if you dine in. Although getting cookies alacarte from togo may be a better idea. Dine in experience was nice. The coffee was excellent. The reindeer cookie was better than the chocolate cookie.
**menu ordered: caramel latte ￥700, choco chips ￥450 it's such a cute spot to snap some pics with your friend! though i have to admit, the cookies and coffee weren't anything too special.

rv.t: Great place for yummy cookies! Most of the time I prefer to take the cookies to go, as the cafe can be pretty crowded. However, when there’s space available it’s nice to sit in the cafe and enjoy the atmosphere. The cafe always has cute decorations, and the drinks and sweets are all very pretty. Like many cafes in Shin-Okubo, it’s good for oshikatsu! To sit at the cafe, every person must order at least one drink…

These cookies looked DELICIOUS. we ordered 3 and we had high expectations for how yummy they looked. But sadly they were cold and wet-ish. We didn’t want to bring them home to heat up. But these would probably taste so much better heated up. Cute atmosphere though

Very cute and quiet café. The caramel lotus cookie was delicious, and the hot latte was great too. Unfortunately, the seasonal Nutella roll was less successful — it lacked that rich, nutty flavor you’d expect. The café is stroller and wheelchair friendly, with an elevator available in the building.

I liked this ramen quite a bit due to the uniqueness of the broth and the homemade texture of the noodles. I dinned alone. 😞 which afforded me the time to focus on the ramen. rv.t: Delicious local takoyaki made with rice puffs and prawn powder, cheesy inside too! The toppings such as sauce, mayo and flakes are free flow refills
First time trying takoyaki with a crispy puff, and it was actually really good & pretty unique too. The place isn’t so big, but its a nice spot to grab a beer, have some food & chat for a while.

Want hot quick cheap local takoyaki? Then this is your spot. Literally I ordered and 25 seconds later pipping hot takoyaki arrived. I was Staying nearby wanted to try the famous dish. This place did the trick. 10 takoyaki for 660¥ is a steal. You self-sauce which I thought was a bit of fun, meaning you can try different ratio combos to see which you like best - I opted for mayonnaise, special sauce with bento flakes.

Very Normal food, best is open to 2300hrs. It was crowded when I look from outside and decided to give try after so many time walk by this restaurant. But the food was just very normal.

If you’re traveling through Shin-Osaka Station and need a quick meal, Messekuma Shin-Osaka is definitely a convenient option. 1059.edj: このキャンプ場を利用した人は、新しくてきれいな設備を高く評価しています。特に、お手洗いやシャワーは非常に清潔で、品揃えの豊富な売店も好評のようです。また、穏やかな湖の景色や水上アクティビティを楽しめること、スタッフの対応が親切であることも魅力として挙げられています。 一方で、騒音の問題が気になるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: I love this campsite. we always go back here because of the view and we feel safe and the staff are nice. I love everything about here. the toilet and shower are nice, always clean and newly built. The only thing that I hope they change is when you book a site you will not know the assigned site until the day you arrive. You still can request if you have a desired site but its not assured. So I recommend going on…

The office staff were really supportive and helpful. Only that I wish they have watapps and lines to be able to communicate faster and more effectively. Otherwise, using email is also a good way to check reservation and confirmation. They can communicate English so that makes life easier for foreign tourists. I truly recommend this camping site. However do make sure you are prepared for the weather and climate…

Even though there is not view of Mt. Fuji, it is a good place for auto camping, by the lake. And the lake water is so clear. Families enjoying, along with their pets. It’s perfect for summertime as you can indulge in the lake too. Its a 4 star because the facilities are limited and since it is by the side of the road, you’ll be often disturbed by cars passing-by. Book in advance and they get full pretty quickly!

Good flavor and really fun. When the robots come to deliver your meal, everything can be ordered nice and easy through a multilingual tablet and everything arise hot and quickly. We enjoyed the Deluxe meal with beef, chicken, and pork. We came without the kiddos, but they have plenty of options if you had munchkins in tow. The flavor here in Japan is a little sweeter than I'm used to in Taiwan, but still delicious…

Absolutely delicious. It took a little bit to learn how to order but the staff was very friendly and helpful. The food was absolutely delicious. We highly recommend. The food was so good, I forgot to take pictures.
